meta.name: pain-identifier
meta.description: Identify and prioritize evidence-based pain points a target company likely faces, based on growth signals, tech stack, hiring activity, and industry context. Use when asked "what are [company]'s pain points", "research pain points for [company]", "why would [company] buy", "what problems does [company] face", "qualify this lead", "account research for [company]", "help me personalize outreach to [company]", or "what signals should I mention in my email to [company]".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 识别目标公司的核心痛点，辅助销售外联
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做B2B销售或市场研究，需要快速了解潜在客户的痛点。
copy.tagline_en: Identify core pain points of target companies to aid sales outreach
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do B2B sales or market research and need quick insights into prospect pain points.

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 会分析目标公司的招聘、融资、技术栈等信号，找出具体且证据充分的痛点，并按优先级排序，同时提供个性化的外联策略。
howto.when: 当你询问「[公司名]的痛点」、要求做账户研究、或请求个性化外联时触发。例如说「what are Acme's pain points」或「research pain points for Acme」。

say.note: Claude会要求补充你的产品信息，然后输出分析报告

say.text: Acme公司有哪些潜在问题，我该怎么在邮件里提？
say.note: Claude会挖掘痛点并给出邮件切入角度

say.text: 我的产品是销售培训，帮我看看Acme公司的痛点
say.note: Claude会根据你的产品定位筛选可解决的痛点

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude will analyze a target company's signals (hiring, funding, tech stack) to identify evidence-based pain points, prioritize them, and suggest personalized outreach angles.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a company's pain points, account research, or personalized outreach, e.g., 'what are [company]'s pain points' or 'research pain points for [company]'.

say_en.note: Claude will ask for your product info, then output a report

say_en.text: What problems does Acme face, and how should I mention them in an email?
say_en.note: Claude will uncover pains and suggest outreach angles

say_en.text: My product is sales training. Help me research Acme's pain points.
say_en.note: Claude will filter pains relevant to your solution
